title: Dual $L_p$ John ellipsoids for general measures
summary: The dual $L_p$ John ellipsoids form a family that includes the origin-centered Löwner and Legendre ellipsoids. In this paper, we extend this family to general measures within the dual weighted $L_p$ Brunn--Minkowski theory. For measures with locally integrable densities that are continuous in a neighborhood of the boundary of the given star body, we establish a variational formula for $L_p$-harmonic radial combinations.
